content.introduction: The U.S. GDP growth rate was 2.1% in March 2026, and the unemployment rate was 4.2% in June 2026. The World Bank lists GDP per capita and poverty headcount ratio among its indicators. Moody's Analytics reports a K-shaped economy with top 20% income earners accounting for nearly 60% of personal outlays.

The K-shaped economy remains firmly intact, with those in the top 20% of the income distribution accounting for an astonishing nearly 60% of personal outlays, up from about half in the early 1990s.
